user.title: Add a door
user.description: A garage door or gate driven by single pulses, with a contact that only reports closed.

data_description.name: Optional. Leave empty for the pulse cover's name plus Timer. Entity ids always follow the pulse cover, for example cover.front_gate_timer.
data_description.source_entity: The cover whose open and close commands send the controller a pulse.
data_description.closed_contact: Off when the door is closed, on otherwise.

abort.already_configured: This pulse cover already has a door.

data_description.source_entity: The cover whose open and close commands send the controller a pulse. Changing it moves this door's entities to that cover's device; their entity ids stay as they are.
data_description.closed_contact: Off when the door is closed, on otherwise.
data_description.full_open_time: From a pulse at closed to fully open.
data_description.full_close_time: From a pulse at fully open to the closed contact.
data_description.sensor_offset: How far into an opening the closed contact lets go. An opening first seen from the contact (fob, app) starts this far in.
data_description.motor_allowance: Added to a reverse back up after a stop on the way down (motor start and ease; nothing confirms the top).
data_description.close_margin: Added to the full close time on every closing run before the door is called obstructed. Never delays closed.
data_description.closed_settle_time: How long the contact must stay closed before the door counts as closed. 0 for most doors; raise it for a gate that reports closed while still tensioning.

error.already_configured: That pulse cover already has a door.
